purpose: paired, deterministic simulation-development sensitivity; no physical parameter distribution or paper abstention calibration
model_set_basis: Use only the four passing paired front/rear fits from prior synthetic identification; keep each pair together. These are sensitivity assumptions, not measured car uncertainty or independent draws.
other_vehicle_parameters: exact F110Env default values at pinned simulator source; only C_Sf and C_Sr vary
pairing: all three unordered controller pairs on identical map, line, model, start, seed and integration/control schedules; each scenario has one deterministic run per controller
nominal_rule: rerun nominal with explicit default params and verify against previously frozen evaluation to 0.002 s Gym finish and 0.00001 m independent RMS; stop if it differs
pilot: run example nominal PP for 2 simulated seconds with explicit params and confirm finite telemetry, valid hashes, full parameter pass-through and no collision; then run full nominal before nonnominal models
comparison: signed Gym finish time A minus B; report noncompletion separately with null lap time; sign reversal only when nominal and variant absolute differences both exceed the near-tie bound
latency: ideal simulated-time actuation, measured compute duration and 10 ms deadline misses reported; fixed command-delay sensitivity remains separate and is not a probability distribution
scope: development simulation only; no real-platform transfer, inferred model distribution, reserved group, physical driving or paper ranking
